name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
benefit: Financial assistance to build a pucca house for eligible rural households without one
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
notes: Income threshold is an approximation; the deprivation list decides.

rules.text: Family lives in a kutcha or houseless home
Annual family income is at or below about Rs 3 lakh (approximation, check the deprivation list)

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Check the Awaas Soft list or ask the gram panchayat whether your name is in the survey list
Keep the acknowledgement and check the status on the PMAY-G portal
Note the application number and follow up with the gram panchayat
